project_meta.current_focus: Rebuild plugin admin from approved frames without losing WordPress constraints.
project_meta.operational_mantra: Como isso vai continuar funcionando depois que eu parar de explicar?

phase_0_system_creation.why_this_preset_fits: The UI lives inside WordPress admin and must preserve plugin settings, but the success source is approved visual frames.
phase_0_system_creation.legacy_integration_strategy: Extract existing save behavior and admin options, discard previous visual structure, rebuild from approved frames.
dangerous_uncertainty: approved frames may contain impossible or hallucinated details
WordPress admin chrome constrains exact pixel matching

briefing_layer.what_i_understood: The admin must feel like a product system inside WordPress, not like a styled default settings page.
what_is_crystallized: Filters, CPTs, and Integrations are real admin areas
Frames are the visual source of success
Simple Budget is frozen for this phase
what_is_foggy: Exact runtime depth of each integration module
Which visual artifacts are hallucinations to correct in code
decisions_becoming_contract: No standalone admin outside WordPress chrome
Screenshot QA is required before closing visual tasks

tasks.title: Plano-mae e ancoragem operacional
acceptance_criteria: Preset and secondary preset are declared
Frame source of truth is documented
Old admin code is treated as behavior reference only

budgets.context_budget: read planning files plus approved frame notes only
budgets.validation_budget: human validation required for frame interpretation

anchoring_contract.central_objective: Create executable admin rebuild tasks from approved frames and WordPress constraints.
anchoring_contract.anti_expansion_rule: Any integration runtime work becomes a future subplan, not part of this admin rebuild.

tasks.title: Frame inventory and visual contracts
acceptance_criteria: Each approved frame maps to a state of the same layout
Hallucinated frame details are marked as corrected-in-code
Desktop and mobile validation requirements are attached

budgets.context_budget: approved frames and frame-driven QA protocol
budgets.validation_budget: must request validation if source frame is missing

subtasks.title: List frames and states
subtasks.expected_output: Frame inventory with state names and target viewport assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: No frame is treated as a separate product if it is a state of the same layout

subplans.title: Visual QA Loop
subplans.purpose: Compare implementation screenshots to approved frames in bounded iterations.
subplans.scope_boundary: Only visual fidelity and usability of admin frames.
subplans.entry_condition: A screen state has been implemented.
subplans.exit_condition: Screenshot evidence shows acceptable match and no layout breakage.
subplans.allowed_expansion: Add targeted CSS or component corrections.
subplans.forbidden_expansion: Redesign frame architecture or add runtime features.
subplans.handoff_notes: If screenshot evidence is missing, the visual task is not done.

handoff_to_next_ai.mission: Use the visual contracts and task order to rebuild the admin without rethinking the product direction.
what_not_to_rethink: The admin stays inside WordPress chrome
Frames are source of visual success
handoff_to_next_ai.first_action_next_ai_should_take: Open the approved frame inventory and generate TASK-003 for shared admin component architecture.
